Sandbox_Cat_BankingSystem_WalletDropChan: Percent chance for a zombie to drop a wallet (0-100).
Sandbox_Cat_BankingSystem_WalletMinMoney: Minimum amount of money (in dollars) found in a zombie wallet.
Sandbox_Cat_BankingSystem_WalletMaxMoney: Maximum amount of money (in dollars) found in a zombie wallet.
Sandbox_Cat_BankingSystem_WalletCreditCa: Percent chance for a zombie wallet to also contain a credit card (0-100).
